notes:
Overview:
- Lodehaven builds a SaaS knowledge base for mid-market B2B apps (customer help centers + internal KB).
- POC focused on embeddings + reranking pipeline; they want to reduce misranked responses on edge cases.
Scale & perf targets:
- Indexing scope: ~2.5M docs (help articles, KB pages, attachments) ~12M embedding vectors after chunking.
- Query profile: bursty but sustained high QPS target: 400-600 QPS peak, 250-350 sustained QPS expected.
- Latency goal: p95 end-to-end < 150ms for top-5 rerank path (ANN + reranker). Cost sensitivity: looking to halve current per-query cost.
Current stack / baseline:
- Using vendor X (managed vector DB) + self-hosted reranker; baseline POC: 120 QPS, p95 ~220ms, cost ~$0.045/query.
Why Redwood evaluation:
- Interested in hosted API to remove vector infra ops; like Redwood's unified routing and prefix/KV caching.
- Needs intelligent batching suggestions, quantization guidance to hit cost SLOs.
- Want built-in fallback models for seasonal load.
Security & compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) and provide audit logs for search queries; legal asking about retention controls and ability to redact logs on request.
POC plan & timeline:
- 2026-02-04 discovery call (see ff_2026-02-04_9a3f2b).
- 2026-02-18 demo (generated sample with Redwood hosted embeddings + lightweight reranker).
- POC: run 1-week staging run on hosted_api, then 1-hour sustained load test at 500 QPS (target date: 2026-03-15).
- Acceptance criteria: p95 <150ms and cost per effective query <= $0.02.
Recent activity / notes from calls:
- "If we can get p95 under 150ms at 500 QPS and cut costs by 40%, procurement will push this live Q3." — CTO paraphrase.
- SE feedback: consider deploying caching on common query prefixes + using smaller reranker on short docs to save tokens.
Open items for AE/SE:
- Confirm whether Redwood hosted embeddings can be sharded by tenant to meet EU data residency requirements.
- Get a sample throughput quote for 500 QPS with autoscaling and estimated token cost breakdown.
- Legal to review Redwood security FAQ (drive link shared).
Next actions (short):
- Maya: schedule the 1-hour load run and send SAML attribute spec to their IdP admin.
